why.title: Driven by real adopters, not checklists
why.description: Whatever ships in this layer is shaped by what early users actually need in production — not a feature checklist written in a vacuum.

why.title: Built on the same OSS engine
why.description: Nothing in this layer breaks or hides the open core. The engine you install today is the same engine larger organizations will run.

why.title: Stronger governance and support
why.description: Stricter policy controls, audit boundaries, commercial support, SLA — the things larger organizations ask for once they're past the install.

why.title: Honest about what's not here yet
why.description: What ships today: the OSS engine. What's roadmap: the rest of this page. Nothing is sold before it ships.
